pairs.why: Both are similar soft clay renders, but A's bigger, chunkier dome fills the frame the way the real cards' objects do, while B is a smaller object in a wider scene.
A is a clean, sculpted hat with a crisp band and badge, like the real cards; B has a fuzzy texture and an odd flat brim with a pale rim, so it looks less like a real object.
The two are almost identical; B's rope reads a touch softer and smoother, which is the direction the lessons favour.
B's coil is smoother and more compact, close to the soft finish of the real scarf and fan; A's thin, strongly twisted strands are the texture-heavy look the lessons rejected.
B's thick, smooth rope tubes with soft shading match the real cards' finish better than A's finer, more textured strands.
A's chunky, puffy coil with soft, rounded twists reads like the real scarf and spyglass, while B's thin, heavily textured lasso is the over-textured look the lessons rejected.
Same as p142: B's smoother, compact coil fits the real cards better than A's thin, texture-heavy rope.
Same as p143: B's smooth, chunky rope is closer to the real cards' soft finish than A's detailed twist texture.
